verdicts.originalText: Casting the Skill puts Lohen into Masterstroke mode for 13s. While in it his Normal and Charged Attacks turn into Cryo damage, he builds up "Joy" (used to unleash the special skill Etched Into Bone and Soul), and nearby teammates build up "Will to Win" for him. Masterstroke ends the moment Lohen swaps off-field. The special-skill damage and the Joy / Will to Win resources are Lohen's own on-field damage and aren't shown here.
verdicts.proposedText: Not modeled: the special skill Etched Into Bone and Soul and the Joy / Will to Win resources — on-field mechanics the timeline doesn't show.
verdicts.rationale: Mixed caveat. The stance entry (Masterstroke 13s via behavior:'stance', terminatesOnSwap) and the Cryo self-infusion are both modeled and rendered, so describing them is working behavior. The load-bearing part is a genuine omission: the special skill Etched Into Bone and Soul and its Joy / Will to Win resources are self on-field damage the tool never shows. Compress to that omission; drop the working-behavior description. [Adjudicated per wave-4 verifier downgrade.]

verdicts.originalText: The Burst consumes all of Lohen's stored "Will to Win" and its damage scales with how much was consumed. This is Lohen's own on-field damage and isn't shown here. If cast during Masterstroke, it extends that mode by 1.65s.
verdicts.proposedText: Not modeled: the on-field damage, which scales with how much Will to Win is consumed. Casting during Masterstroke also extends that mode by 1.65s — not shown.
verdicts.implementQueueNote: The +1.65s Masterstroke extension on an in-stance burst cast is authorable via a durationExtensions effect fired onCast, gated on state:inStance (onCast durationExtensions are on the CAN list). Currently unauthored — this ability has effects: []. Caveat is accurate today, so it stays a rewrite, not implementDelete.
verdicts.rationale: Both parts are genuine omissions, not working behavior. The burst's damage/resource consumption is self on-field DPS the tool never shows, and the +1.65s Masterstroke extension is real but unauthored (effects: []), so the stance window would render short. Compress both; flag the extension for the authoring queue.

verdicts.originalText: While Lohen is in Masterstroke mode, when a teammate triggers a Cryo reaction (Melt, Freeze, Superconduct, or a Cryo swirl/crystallize) both that teammate and Lohen gain +15% ATK for 8s.
verdicts.proposedText: The buff is shown only on the on-field character — in game the teammate who triggered the reaction also keeps their +15% ATK, which the timeline doesn't show.
verdicts.rationale: The entire caveat restates a fully-modeled buff (effect: onReaction, source:team, reaction list melt/frozen/superConduct/cryoSwirl/cryoCrystallize, +15 atk%, 8s refresh, gated state:inStance, target ['self','active']). onReaction dispatch and buff windows are wired end-to-end, so the timeline shows this correctly — describing it is working behavior. A player would not be misled without the note. No stated warning is lost by deleting; the genuine approximations are curator-facing and already documented. [Adjudicated per wave-4 verifier downgrade.]

The only genuine divergences are curator-facing and already in _curatorNotes: source:'team' stands in for the kit's 'another nearby party member' (onReaction has no 'others' source), and target 'active' cannot perfectly express an off-field reactor. verdicts.originalText: At C2, roughly every 4s Lohen's follow-up "Evilsbane Blade" strike (during Masterstroke) grants other party members +200 Elemental Mastery for 8s. The strike's own 500% ATK Cryo damage is Lohen's on-field damage and isn't shown here.
verdicts.proposedText: Not modeled: the Evilsbane Blade follow-up strike's own 500% ATK Cryo damage — on-field damage the timeline doesn't show.
verdicts.rationale: Mixed caveat. The +200 EM buff to other party members is fully modeled (effect: onHit, target teamExcludingSelf, em 200, 8s refresh, procCooldown 4 for the once-per-4s cap, gated state:inStance) and rendered — describing it is working behavior. The genuine omission is the follow-up strike's 500% ATK Cryo self on-field damage. Compress to that omission; drop the buff description.
